1.name: POWER PLUS
1.desc: Bio-Enriched Organic Manure. Manufactured using modern technology, Power Plus provides complete nutrition, improves soil health, and ensures abundant yields. It is rich in organic carbon, bio-energy bacteria (Azotobacter, PSB, etc.), and growth boosters like Humic and Amino acids.

2.name: Bio DAP
2.desc: Granular Bio-Fertilizer. The best alternative to chemical DAP. It contains Rock Phosphate, organic matter, and Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria (PSB) to make fixed phosphorus available to crops. Enhances soil fertility and promotes root development.

usageTable.title: Usage per Acre
rows: As a base fertilizer or as a top-dressing (supplementary) fertilizer.

3.name: BIO N.P.K.
3.desc: Granular Bio-Fertilizer. A complete 'Bio-System' that revitalizes the soil. It fixes Nitrogen from the air, solubilizes soil Phosphorus, and mobilizes Potash. Coated with Humic, Amino, and Seaweed extract for stress protection and root development.

usageTable.title: Usage per Acre
rows: As a base fertilizer or as a top-dressing (supplementary) fertilizer.

4.name: Carbon X
4.desc: Granular Organic Manure. A balanced mix of nutrients essential for both soil and crops. Rich in Organic Carbon, Humic, Natural NPK, Calcium, and Magnesium. It improves soil porosity, moisture retention, and provides steady nutrition for a strong crop.

usageTable.title: Application Rate (Per Acre)
rows: As base fertilizer (at the time of sowing)

5.name: UGAM
5.desc: (Bio-Stimulant) Soil conditioner and crop growth enhancer. UGAM is not just a fertilizer, but 'nectar' for your soil. It is a powerful mixture of humic, fulvic, and amino acids that revitalizes the plant from root to tip.

usageTable.title: Application Rate (Per Acre)
rows: 500 grams to 1 kg per acre (via soil)
Via spray pump or soil/drip application

6.name: Prakruti Kavach
6.desc: The power of 10 natural extracts - complete crop protection and vigorous growth. It also provides nutrition to the plant and naturally gives it the strength to fight against diseases and pests.

usageTable.title: Usage and Method
rows: 200 to 300 ml in a 15-liter water pump
Spray every 10 to 20 days to keep the crop safe
Can be started from when the crop is small after sowing seeds

7.name: Rakshak
7.desc: Neem Power: Nature's Protector for Crops. The only organic remedy against sucking pests and fungi. It has a tremendous effect on both chewing and sucking types of insects. Rakshak is a high-quality organic insecticide prepared from neem extract.

usageTable.title: Usage Instructions
rows: 30 to 50 ml per 15 Liter pump (Depending on infestation)
Spray thoroughly on upper and lower sides of leaves.
Every 10-15 days as a precaution or when pests are seen.

8.name: RootVeda
8.desc: The True Veda of the Root - Mycorrhizal Biofertilizer. A technology of nature that increases the spread of the plant's roots by 10 times, drawing nutrients from deep within the soil.

usageTable.title: Usage Method
rows: Mix with any organic fertilizer (dung manure) or dissolve in water for irrigation.

9.name: RhizoSpark
9.desc: Rhizobium Nitrogen Fixing Bacteria. A bio-fertilizer that draws nitrogen from the air and gives it to the crop, reducing the need for chemical fertilizers like urea.

usageTable.title: Usage Method
rows: Mix RhizoSpark with a suitable sticker solution. Dry in shade before sowing.
Mix with sufficient water or organic fertilizer and apply near the root zone at the time of sowing or during early growth.
A second dose is recommended 30 to 45 days after sowing.

10.name: Kwik N.P.K.
10.desc: N.P.K Consortia Biofertilizer. A powerful mixture of Nitrogen, Phosphorus, and Potassium fixing bacteria. Kwik N.P.K. is not just a fertilizer, but a means of bringing the soil to life. The bacteria of all three main elements (N-P-K) in it dissolve the insoluble nutrients lying in the soil and deliver them directly to the plant's roots.

usageTable.title: Usage Method
rows: Spray light water on seeds, mix Kwik N.P.K., dry in shade.
Mix in 100-200L water, give via Drip or Irrigation.
Recommended to repeat dose after 30-45 days of sowing.

11.name: Sarthi
11.desc: Increase the power of your medicine - not a single drop will go to waste! Sarthi works to increase the effectiveness of the medicine and deliver it across the leaves.

usageTable.title: How to use
rows: Only 5 to 7 ml in a 15-liter pump.
First, fill the pump with water.
Add the respective insecticide or fungicide.
Finally, add Sarthi and mix well.

12.name: Samruddhi
12.desc: (Bio-Stimulant) The 'Powerhouse' that enhances the amazing growth of flowers and fruits. A scientifically prepared plant tonic that increases the reproductive power of the crop.

usageTable.title: Details
rows: By spraying on the crop (Foliar Spray).
Cotton, Chilli, Tomato, Soybean, Cumin, Pomegranate, and all vegetables, as well as for horticultural crops.

13.name: VIRAT SUPAR
13.desc: Fast-acting liquid formula for foliage health.

14.name: RAXAK
14.desc: Fast-acting liquid formula for foliage health.

15.name: PRAKRUTI KAVACH 1LTRE
15.desc: Fast-acting liquid formula for foliage health.

16.name: Micro Gold
16.desc: SEEDICA® MICRO GOLD is an advanced 100% water-soluble chelated micronutrient fertilizer formulated with a premium amino acid and botanical base. Ingredients: Zinc, Iron, Manganese, Copper, Boron, Molybdenum, premium amino acids and botanical extracts. It supports rapid nutrient absorption, balanced crop development and overall crop vitality, helping meet micronutrient requirements at critical stages of crop growth.

usageTable.title: Application and Dosage
rows: Per 15-liter pump; apply every 10–15 days during vegetative and flowering stages.
Per 200 liters of water for one acre; use during active growth, flowering and fruiting stages.
Mix with soil or organic fertilizer during transplanting, branching, flowering or fruiting stages.
Per liter of water; adjust according to crop condition and requirement.
